name: yojana-workspace
description: yojana: plans as checkable contracts. Requirement-level revision log, ports & adapters for storage, sync, parsing, verification and work links. Self-contained so the whole directory can be extracted to its own repo.

scripts.boundaries: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs yojana-core/src yojana-store/src yojana-sync/src yojana-markdown/src yojana-verify/src yojana/src cli/src
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run boundaries && bun run test
